bundle.shortDescription: LAN-only file, clipboard, and chat transfer
bundle.longDescription: Fluxy moves files, folders, clipboard text, and chat between devices on the same local network. It pairs devices with a six-digit code, pins their certificates, and never routes traffic through a server.
